laws.statement: A dead hero or Master cannot be restored by story direction or mission reward.
Retreat preserves bodily, social, and informational consequences from the attempt.
A discovery may affect later events only through a living holder of its evidence.
Optional expression and complications cannot replace a floor primary objective.
Only authored triggers and successful extraction can grant band rewards.

openingFacts: The recovered fragment states that Hearth 01 was not the first settlement.
The first company has survived five floors but has no inherited allegiance to the Master.
Floor 06 opens only after the Foundry Warden falls and the archive fragment is extracted.

mechanicCatalog.summary: Evidence can influence later choices only through living characters who hold it.
Declared enemy targets and positioning make party formation an inspectable choice.
Ordinary inspection and movement actions can expose authored alternate routes.
Exposed impacts can create injuries that survive mission return and alter relationships.
Attempt-local cargo becomes canonical only after a successful extraction event.
Separated groups pass holder-owned evidence through a bounded relay action.
A visible entity must survive authored pressure until the extraction condition opens.

enemyFamily.theme: Record-keeping constructs preserve commands and tallies while treating unregistered people as omissions.

dutyCatalog.summary: Patrol fixed record paths and investigate changes to their sequence.
Move toward voices or bells that do not match the current register.
Hold the threshold of a vault containing erased settlement records.
Separate the living holder of evidence that contradicts the register.
Retreat with the nearest intact record rather than pursue a defeated target.

brief.emotionalQuestion: When the tower remembers every command but not every person, will the company preserve one another's names or let useful sacrifice become procedure?
brief.desiredSettlementConsequence: A recovered register can establish a memorial station in Hearth 01 without identifying every erased settlement yet.

proposals.title: The Names We Carry
proposals.thesis: A company becomes accountable when its members preserve the people whom systems reduce to useful losses.
proposals.logline: The company follows the recovered archive into a registry that remembers every order but has methodically erased the people who paid for them.
emotionalProgression: Division gives earlier choices a name.
The company chooses what remembrance costs.

floors.title: The Uncounted Bell
floors.narrativeTurn: A bell answers the archive fragment but its ledger records the party as equipment rather than people.
floors.mechanicalJob: Use ordinary inspection and holder-bound evidence to identify the bell's authored signal path.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The registry has preserved commands from an earlier settlement while removing every personal name.

floors.optionalBeat: A patient listener can locate an alternate stair by comparing the missing intervals between bell strikes.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: Only the hero who inspects the ledger can testify that the omissions were deliberate.

floors.title: Witness Under Glass
floors.narrativeTurn: A damaged index can expose one erased settlement, but Bellkeepers classify its living carrier as a corrupt record.
floors.mechanicalJob: Protect the index carrier while declared formations redirect pressure from a fixed threshold.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The Bellkeepers call the removal of a person's name a correction rather than a death.

floors.optionalBeat: A holder may reveal the Floor 06 omission to redirect one patrol without changing the protection objective.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: Any wound taken for the carrier persists and changes who believes the record was worth saving.

floors.title: Two Exits, One Ledger
floors.narrativeTurn: The safest exit abandons a partial register while the archive route exposes its carrier to a separating patrol.
floors.mechanicalJob: Choose a route under formation and wound pressure; neither route can remove the authored extraction condition.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The low-risk exit cannot carry the partial register out of Floor 08.

floors.optionalBeat: A discovered service passage reduces exposure but requires the evidence holder to cross last.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: The chosen route records whether the company valued survival, evidence, or a specific holder most.

floors.title: The Cost Column
floors.narrativeTurn: The registry reconstructs the company's earlier commands as a tally of who absorbed their consequences.
floors.mechanicalJob: Recover a bounded register leaf while holder knowledge opens only the routes earned on prior floors.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The recovered leaf binds each recorded order to the unnamed person who bore its cost.

floors.optionalBeat: A witness to a prior wound can annotate one cost without naming or reviving the dead.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: The leaf remains attempt-local cargo until extraction and can still be lost on retreat.

floors.title: Keeper of the Blank Line
floors.narrativeTurn: The senior Bellkeeper offers a perfect command history if the company surrenders the names that make its costs personal.
floors.mechanicalJob: Defeat the authored keeper, preserve the register as cargo, and reach extraction inside the fixed reward budget.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The senior Bellkeeper intentionally preserved useful commands while erasing the people who made them possible.

floors.optionalBeat: A living evidence holder may state whose cost the ledger concealed, changing expression but not victory conditions.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: Successful extraction makes the register available for a Hearth memorial station; failure preserves only witnessed knowledge.

finaleConstraints: The senior Bellkeeper must be confronted and defeated through the authored primary objective.
No erased person is restored, named without evidence, or converted into a reward-bearing character.
The register and memorial materials become canonical only after successful extraction.
proposals.settlementConsequence: Hearth 01 may build a memorial station that links future commands to their witnessed human costs.
productionRisks: The ledger language may become exposition-heavy unless each fact is earned through action.
Protecting a carrier must preserve autonomous hero choices instead of turning the party into escorts.
openQuestions: Should the memorial station change daily routines or remain a journal and conversation affordance?
How much of an earlier settlement can the register reveal without resolving the larger campaign mystery?

proposals.title: The Counted Silence
proposals.thesis: Silence can protect a company in the moment while making its absent members easier for authority to erase.
proposals.logline: A tower registry rewards the company for moving without names or testimony, splitting survival from the duty to remain known to one another.
emotionalProgression: Isolation turns trust into a tactical cost.
The missing testimony changes what the tower records.
The company decides whether being remembered is worth exposure.

floors.title: Quiet Entry
floors.narrativeTurn: A noiseless route opens easily, but the Bellkeepers record only commands spoken where they can be heard.
floors.mechanicalJob: Discover a route by contrasting patrol response to movement, inspection, and attributed sound.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The registry preserves an unattributed action but discards the silent person who performed it.

floors.optionalBeat: Waiting through a patrol cycle reveals where the registry listens rather than where it looks.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: Only witnesses to the silent action can later restore its human attribution.

floors.title: The Speaking Burden
floors.narrativeTurn: A damaged witness index survives only while someone speaks its names, drawing every listening patrol.
floors.mechanicalJob: Protect a visible objective while formation and sound-responsive duties make testimony costly.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The damaged index retains a name only while a living holder continues its testimony.

floors.optionalBeat: A second witness may alternate the burden if both already hold the same evidence.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: Wounds and witnessed protection shape who will volunteer to carry testimony again.

floors.title: Voices Across Stone
floors.narrativeTurn: Separated groups can preserve the route or the names, but the relay cannot transmit evidence nobody in the sending group holds.
floors.mechanicalJob: Use a bounded party relay under route and formation pressure without granting remote omniscience.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The relay carries only evidence already held by a living sender and heard by a living receiver.

floors.optionalBeat: A previously shared fact can open the quieter exit for the separated group that received it.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: The route records who was kept informed and who was treated as expendably silent.

floors.title: Record of No Reply
floors.narrativeTurn: The registry presents every earlier silence as consent, forcing the company to confront what it failed to witness.
floors.mechanicalJob: Recover a correction plate through holder-bound routes while earlier relay choices constrain legal testimony.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The earlier settlement's registry converted every unanswered command into a record of consent.

floors.optionalBeat: A holder of contradictory evidence may annotate one record without rewriting the original event.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: The correction plate remains attempt-local and cannot repair testimony the company never shared.

floors.title: The Last Auditor
floors.narrativeTurn: The Last Auditor offers safe passage if the company accepts that unrecorded people never opposed the commands that killed them.
floors.mechanicalJob: Defeat the authored Auditor while protecting the correction plate and extracting within fixed consequence bounds.

requiredAnchor.immutableFact: The Last Auditor authored the rule that transformed missing testimony into consent.

floors.optionalBeat: Two living holders may deliver a joint correction whose wording changes with their relationship, never its fact.
floors.carryForwardConsequence: Extraction can establish a Hearth testimony practice; retreat preserves only what surviving witnesses remember.

finaleConstraints: The Last Auditor remains an authored confrontation and cannot be bypassed by testimony alone.
Silence is never retroactively assigned a speaker, belief, consent, or hidden fact.
The correction plate and any settlement upgrade require successful extraction.
proposals.settlementConsequence: Hearth 01 may establish a testimony practice that records attributed dissent alongside future commands.
productionRisks: The split-party relay needs a proof that player-facing information never becomes hero knowledge automatically.
Sustained speaking must remain a tactical action rather than a repetitive dialogue prompt.
openQuestions: Is the testimony practice legible as a settlement consequence without adding a sixth building?
Should the Last Auditor react to player silence, hero silence, or only canonical communication events?
